channel.title: AI Site Scan changelog
channel.description: New checks and changes in AI Site Scan, the free AI readiness scan for websites.

item.title: Version 3.2.0: can AI agents use your site?
item.description: Every scan now opens your page in a real browser, the way ChatGPT agent, Claude in Chrome and Gemini do. See the page as a list of named buttons and links, a screenshot with every pop-up marked, and an agent grade from A to F.

item.title: Version 3.1.0: how AI Site Scan compares
item.description: A new page compares AI Site Scan with HubSpot AI Search Grader, Semrush AI Agent Readiness, Hostinger AI Visibility Checker, Cloudflare isitagentready.com and Otterly.AI, with sources.

item.title: Version 3.0.1: one-click rescan and safer emails
item.description: Scan again from My reports now uses your included rescan in one click. The report email attaches the fix guide as a Markdown file, and the score no longer counts up twice after you pay.

item.title: Version 3.0.0: accounts, saved reports and Pro
item.description: Log in with an email code or Google. Full reports are emailed and saved in your account. New plans: Full report $19 once (1 site, 1 rescan within 30 days) and Pro $29 a month (10 reports).

item.title: Version 2.5.0: full fix guide, llms.txt and AI robots.txt pages
item.description: A paid full fix guide (one-time payment: $19 for one site, $49 for 10 sites) with instant key delivery, new pricing and contact pages, clearer refund and delivery terms, the report and a ready llms.txt by email, an llms.txt checker page and an AI robots.txt checker page.

item.title: Version 2.4.0: agent readiness
item.description: 23 checks of the standards AI agents look for, with a level from 0 to 5.

item.title: Version 2.3.0: one list of issues
item.description: A new one-column report: the score card, one list of issues with the worst first, and closed detail panels.
